title: Regional Grouping Of Countries Of The World
definition: The institutionalized geopolitical, economic, and security-based aggregation of sovereign states based on geographical proximity, shared values, historical ties, or mutual strategic interests.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for GS Paper 1 (World Geography & Distribution of Natural Resources), GS Paper 2 (Bilateral, Regional and Global Groupings involving India), and Prelims (mapping, international treaties, permanent secretariats, and membership criteria).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Regional Grouping Of Countries Of The World.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
